node.statement: Node 1.2 gives ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=25*epsilon_r. Insert U bold-dot S and U bold-dot U^dagger between mu(U,S) and J. The triangle inequality with nodes 1.7.2.1 and 1.7.2.2 gives ||mu(U,S)-J||<=(84+171+25)*epsilon_r=280*epsilon_r. Since S=sigma(U), this is ||mu(U,sigma(U))-J||<=280*epsilon_r.
